nodes.text: @DavidJoffe64 @DrNeilStone Exactly so! HMPV has not changed its properties. However, its host's defence has dramatically changed since Covid and therefore symptoms and inflammation are more severe. However, we can see this happen not only with HMPV, but also with RSV, NV and many other germs.
